Otter.ai vs Fireflies.ai

A side-by-side look at Otter.ai and Fireflies.ai, using the details in each tool profile.

Quick take

Choose Otter.ai when your priority is: individuals and teams that want dependable meeting transcription, searchable notes and AI summaries across common conferencing platforms. Choose Fireflies.ai when your priority is: teams that want meeting capture plus searchable conversation intelligence, integrations and automation across a broad collaboration stack.

Frequently asked questions

What is the main difference between Otter.ai and Fireflies.ai?

Otter.ai: Otter.ai records and transcribes meetings, produces AI notes and answers questions about conversations across major meeting workflows. Fireflies.ai: Fireflies.ai records, transcribes, summarizes and analyzes meetings while connecting conversation data to collaboration and business tools.

When should I choose Otter.ai over Fireflies.ai?

Otter.ai is listed as best for: individuals and teams that want dependable meeting transcription, searchable notes and AI summaries across common conferencing platforms. Fireflies.ai is listed as best for: teams that want meeting capture plus searchable conversation intelligence, integrations and automation across a broad collaboration stack.

Do Otter.ai and Fireflies.ai have a free plan?

Otter.ai: Yes. Fireflies.ai: Yes. Check each official pricing page, as plans change.
